cues.en: So for each recommender algorithm let's look at what's going on.
cues.zh: 接著看看，對每個推薦演算法做了什麼。

cues.en: First we train the recommender algorithm using the full complete training set, since we're not doing train and test here, we just want the best recommendations we can get.
cues.zh: 首先，用完整訓練集訓練推薦演算法；因為這裡不做訓練／測試，只想取得最好的推薦。

cues.en: What we do next is get an anti test set for the user we're interested in.
cues.zh: 接著，取得我們感興趣的使用者的反測試集。

cues.en: All this does is produce a test data set of all the movies that this user did not rate already.
cues.zh: 它只會產生一份測試資料集，包含這位使用者尚未評分的所有電影。

cues.en: Since we don't want to recommend movies that the user has already seen.
cues.zh: 因為不想推薦使用者已經看過的電影。

cues.en: Next we generate rating predictions for every single movie this user hasn't seen and then we sort them all by their predicted ratings.
cues.zh: 接著，預測這位使用者沒看過的每部電影的評分，再依預測評分排序。

cues.en: Plug off the top 10 results, and print them out.
cues.zh: 取出前十個結果，印出來。

cues.en: Again this isn't the most efficient way to do it but for evaluation purposes, it's a good way to go.
cues.zh: 再次提醒，這不是最有效率的方法，但用於評估很適合。

cues.en: So we've seen that Evaluator uses both Evaluated Algorithm and Evaluation Data.
cues.zh: 我們已看過 Evaluator 會使用 EvaluatedAlgorithm 與 EvaluationData。

cues.en: Let's dive into Evaluated Algorithm first and open that up.
cues.zh: 先深入 EvaluatedAlgorithm，開啟它。

cues.en: There's not actually a whole lot to talk about here.
cues.zh: 這裡其實沒有太多需要說明。

cues.en: It's really just a wrapper for a bunch of calls to the recommender metrics module we covered earlier.
cues.zh: 基本上只是把之前介紹過的 RecommenderMetrics 模組呼叫包裝起來。

cues.en: You can see that the evaluates method has an option for top-end hit rate diversity and novelty metrics, so you can avoid the expense of computing these if all you're interested in is accuracy.
cues.zh: 可以看到 Evaluate 方法提供 Top-N 命中率、多樣性與新穎性指標的選項，如果只在意準確程度，就能避開計算它們的成本。

cues.en: It puts all of the evaluation results into a dictionary called metrics, which the evaluator then uses to print out the results of each Evaluated Algorithm side by side.
cues.zh: 所有評估結果都存入名為 metrics 的字典，Evaluator 再用它將每個 EvaluatedAlgorithm 的結果並排印出。

cues.en: If you're new to Python, I encourage you to pause and spend some time studying this code, as it may help you understand the language.
cues.zh: 如果你是 Python 新手，鼓勵你先暫停，花點時間研究這段程式碼，可能有助於理解語言。

cues.en: But in the interest of getting into actual recommendation algorithms more quickly, let's move on.
cues.zh: 但為了更快進入真正的推薦演算法，我們繼續。

cues.en: Open up EvaluationData.py and have a look, as you can see it's just generating all the various train and test splits required by our recommender metrics functions.
cues.zh: 開啟 EvaluationData.py，看看內容。你可以看到，它只是在產生 RecommenderMetrics 函數所需的各種訓練／測試分割。

cues.en: It tucks away a copy of the ranking data needed for novelty, then proceeds to slice and dice our data in various ways.
cues.zh: 它先保留一份計算新穎性所需的排名資料，再用各種方式切分資料。

cues.en: First it creates a full training set used for analyzing the data as a whole, and a full anti test set which contains all of the missing ratings from movies users have not yet rated that need to be predicted.
cues.zh: 首先建立完整訓練集，供整體分析資料使用；也建立完整反測試集，包含使用者尚未評分電影的所有缺失評分，這些是需要預測的。

cues.en: Next we do a 75-25 train and test split of the data used for measuring accuracy.
cues.zh: 接著，以 75 比 25 分割資料為訓練集與測試集，用來衡量準確程度。

cues.en: Again using k-fold cross validation might be a better idea, but it's not really worth the extra time it takes for us.
cues.zh: 同樣地，使用 k 折交叉驗證可能更好，但對我們來說，不值得花額外時間。

cues.en: Next we generate the train and test split needed for measuring hit rates.
cues.zh: 接著，產生衡量命中率所需的訓練／測試分割。

cues.en: Remember we need to use LeaveOneOut cross validation, to withhold one known rating for each user, so we can see if we can successfully recommend that movie in our results or not.
cues.zh: 記得，必須使用 LeaveOneOut 交叉驗證，為每位使用者保留一筆已知評分，才能檢查是否成功在結果中推薦那部電影。

cues.en: Finally we create a similarity matrix, that gives us similarity scores between every possible combination of movies.
cues.zh: 最後，建立相似度矩陣，記錄每種可能電影配對的相似度分數。

cues.en: We need this for computing diversity, to do this we take advantage of surprise lips built in KNNBaseline algorithm, which computes the similarity matrix as part of what it does.
cues.zh: 計算多樣性需要它。為此，利用 SurpriseLib 內建的 KNNBaseline 演算法，它在運作時會計算相似度矩陣。

cues.en: So by training a KNNBaseline with our data, we can access that similarity matrix under its hood later on.
cues.zh: 因此，用我們的資料訓練 KNNBaseline 後，之後就能存取內部的相似度矩陣。

cues.en: Then we just have a bunch of accessors for all of the various splits that we created.
cues.zh: 再來只是一組存取方法，用來取得已建立的各種分割。

cues.en: The only interesting bit of code here, is GetAntiTestSetForUser which gives back a list of empty prediction values for every movie a given user hasn't rated already.
cues.zh: 這裡唯一比較有趣的程式碼是 GetAntiTestSetForUser，會傳回某位使用者尚未評分的每部電影的空白預測值清單。

cues.en: This somewhat cryptic code on line 49 is just extracting a list of the items this user has rated already from the full training set.
cues.zh: 第 49 行這段有點難懂的程式碼，只是從完整訓練集，擷取這位使用者已評分項目的清單。

cues.en: Then on line 50 we construct a bunch of prediction structures, each consisting of an inner user ID and inner item ID and a placeholder rating, which for now is just the global mean of all ratings.
cues.zh: 接著，第 50 行建立一組預測結構，每個包含內部使用者 ID、內部項目 ID，以及一個暫用評分，目前使用所有評分的整體平均值。

cues.en: But we check against that list of stuff the user has already rated, and exclude those to get our anti test set for that user.
cues.zh: 但會對照使用者已評分的項目清單，將它們排除，取得這位使用者的反測試集。

cues.en: Okay so that's it.
cues.zh: 好，就是這樣。

cues.en: So let's get some payoff from all this and see it in action.
cues.zh: 現在來看看這些工作的成果，實際執行一下。

cues.en: Open up RecsBakeOff.py again
cues.zh: 重新開啟 RecsBakeOff.py，

cues.en: and let's see how the SVD recommender does against random recommendations.
cues.zh: 看看 SVD 推薦與隨機推薦相比，表現如何。

cues.en: Click play to let it do its thing...
cues.zh: 按播放，讓它執行……

cues.en: and go get a cup of coffee, catch up on your email or something.
cues.zh: 然後去喝杯咖啡、回個電子郵件之類的。

cues.en: It will take several minutes to complete.
cues.zh: 需要幾分鐘才能完成。

cues.en: Me, I'm gonna go get some lunch, so come back when it's done running.
cues.zh: 我要去吃午餐，執行完再回來吧。
